hero_text: Strong CTC from the tea gardens of Assam, blended with real rose petals and spices from Kerala. Real leaves. Real goodness.
story_title: Two friends, two states, one cup.
story_tagline: Good tea brings good people together
story_text:
Originals began with a friendship between an Assamese girl and a Keralite girl who met while studying together. Long evenings over books turned into long conversations over tea, with strong Assam chai on one side and the spices of Kerala on the other.

We put the two together. Originals is a brand of Lignio Private Limited, made to bring the warmth of that friendship to your everyday cup.
assam_title: Assam, the land of tea and rhinos
assam_short: Rich, malty CTC from the lush tea gardens along the Brahmaputra, home of the one-horned rhino.
assam_text: Assam grows more tea than almost anywhere on earth. Its low, humid plains along the Brahmaputra give CTC tea its deep colour and strong, malty taste, the kind that stands up to milk and sugar.
assam_points: Tea gardens beside Kaziranga, home of the one-horned rhino
kerala_short: Cardamom, cinnamon and clove from the misty hills and backwaters of God's Own Country.
kerala_text: For centuries, traders sailed to Kerala's coast for its spices. Green cardamom grows in the shade of the Western Ghats, and cinnamon, clove and pepper fill its markets.
kerala_points: Cardamom from the hills of the Western Ghats
